name: Ms. Vonalli
source:
Awoke in the forest near Aeston and drug herself out of the ground.
Quickly apprehended by the passing Gravesister Emilia Anomla and found to not be undead or a necromancer.

Suffers from selective amnesia regarding her personal identity but still remembers the basics of the world she's in. Haunted by a 'ghost' in her head which she eventually names 'Vasilisa'.

Hunted by an unknown adversary.
